title: Americans' Use of Social Media in 2026

facts.fact: Per Pew Research Center's National Public Opinion Reference Survey, 84% of U.S. adults say they ever use YouTube, based on the 6/18/2026 survey wave.
Per Pew Research Center's 2026 survey, 70% of U.S. adults say they ever use Facebook.
Per Pew Research Center's 2026 survey, 51% of U.S. adults say they ever use Instagram.
facts.quote: About half of U.S. adults say they use Instagram

facts.fact: Per Pew Research Center's 2026 survey, 37% of U.S. adults say they ever use TikTok.
Per Pew Research Center's 2026 survey, 31% of U.S. adults say they ever use LinkedIn.
Per Pew Research Center's 2026 survey, 33% of U.S. adults say they ever use WhatsApp.
Per Pew Research Center's 2026 survey, 26% of U.S. adults say they ever use Snapchat.
Per Pew Research Center's 2026 survey, 18% of U.S. adults say they ever use X (formerly Twitter), down from 21% in 2025.
Per Pew Research Center's 2026 survey, 25% of U.S. adults say they ever use Reddit.
Per Pew Research Center's 2026 survey, 18% of U.S. adults say they ever use Nextdoor.
Per Pew Research Center's 2026 survey, 4% of U.S. adults say they ever use Truth Social.
Pew Research Center's social media fact sheet is based on the National Public Opinion Reference Survey, a Center survey of 5,511 U.S. adults.
facts.quote: This analysis is based on findings from the National Public Opinion Reference Survey, a Center survey of 5,511 U.S. adults.

facts.fact: The Pew Research Center survey underlying this fact sheet was conducted January 30 to June 18, 2026, with an overall margin of error of plus or minus 1.8 percentage points.
facts.quote: The survey was conducted Jan. 30-June 18, 2026. Its overall margin of error is plus or minus 1.8 percentage points.

facts.fact: Pew Research Center's surveys from 2024 through 2026 were conducted via web, mail and phone, while polls from 2012 to 2021 were conducted via phone and the 2023 poll was conducted via web and mail.
facts.quote: Polls from 2012-2021 were conducted via phone. In 2023, the poll was conducted via web and mail. In 2024 through 2026, the poll was conducted via web, mail and phone.
